firstPlayerRule: The player whose head is most in the clouds starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The chosen player receives starting tile 1. This is the rulebook's playful criterion; it does not define a measurement or equate it with height.
